episode.title: First Contact
episode.style: original cinematic military science fiction animation

bible.visual_style: grounded near-future military science fiction, graphite armor, restrained cyan diagnostics, practical industrial lighting, realistic weight, no copyrighted franchise designs
bible.camera: 35-50mm cinematic lenses, motivated handheld only during combat, smooth dolly and crane moves during discovery scenes, consistent 180-degree screen direction across cuts
bible.palette: graphite, steel blue, amber emergency light, cyan technology accents

characters.name: Commander Mara Voss
characters.armor: graphite command armor with narrow cyan shoulder stripe

characters.name: Jax Mercer
characters.armor: heavy graphite armor with amber utility markings

characters.name: Dr. Imani Vale
characters.armor: graphite technical armor with compact tool rig

characters.name: Rook
characters.armor: light graphite recon armor with compact sensor mast

bible.enemy: Veyr: original biomechanical soldiers with segmented ceramic armor and luminous geometric faceplates
bible.weapons: fictional directed-energy and coil-propelled cinematic props; visually original; no real-world construction detail
continuity_rules: character armor, proportions and markings remain identical across all twenty segments
weapons stay on the same side of each character unless a shot explicitly shows the handoff
injury and dirt state only increase unless cleaned on screen
segment opening camera and character positions inherit continuity_out from previous segment
music key, ambience and room tone crossfade across segment seams

segments.continuity_out: dropship descending toward Erebus colony
segments.dialogue: KESTREL: Erebus Colony stopped transmitting eleven hours ago. VOSS: No distress beacon? KESTREL: None.

segments.continuity_out: rear ramp opening on empty landing pad
shots: Rook watches silent city through viewport
segments.dialogue: VOSS: We go quiet until we know what happened. JAX: Thirty-eight thousand people do not go quiet. VALE: They do if someone makes them.

segments.continuity_out: squad entering main street
segments.dialogue: ROOK: No bodies. No evacuation traffic. VOSS: Then we find out where everyone went.

segments.continuity_out: Rook kneeling over underground signal marker
segments.dialogue: VALE: Power grid is still carrying full load. ROOK: Movement below us. Slow. Organized.

segments.continuity_out: elevator doors closing on squad
segments.dialogue: VOSS: Kestrel, keep the ship hot. KESTREL: I dislike that expression, but acknowledged.

segments.continuity_out: squad facing freshly cut alien geometry
shots: metal wall cut into geometric pattern
segments.dialogue: VALE: This cut is hours old. Not mining equipment. JAX: Then whoever made it is still here.

segments.continuity_out: dead drone behind Vale begins unfolding
shots: alien cable fused to colony grid
segments.dialogue: VALE: It is drawing power and sending it somewhere. VOSS: Can you trace it? VALE: Give me thirty seconds.

segments.continuity_out: facility lights ignite in sequence
segments.dialogue: ROOK: Signal burst! VOSS: To what? KESTREL: Everything below you.

segments.continuity_out: first Veyr silhouettes at far corridor
segments.dialogue: JAX: That answers who. VALE: Not what they are doing here.

segments.continuity_out: squad retreating under organized enemy fire
segments.dialogue: VOSS: Controlled withdrawal. No heroics. JAX: You always ruin my best ideas.

segments.continuity_out: maintenance blast door sealing behind squad
shots: Vale triggers industrial arm as cover
blast door closes on last energy bolt
segments.dialogue: VALE: Their shots are steering us. VOSS: Then stop going where they want.

segments.continuity_out: team emerging from zero-g shaft into reactor level
segments.dialogue: ROOK: Gravity is gone. KESTREL: Correction: gravity control was redirected. VALE: Toward the reactor.

segments.continuity_out: gateway chamber door visible beyond smoke
shots: smoke clears to giant sealed chamber
segments.dialogue: JAX: Door is yours. VOSS: Keep it that way.

segments.continuity_out: full alien gateway revealed
segments.dialogue: VALE: They did not kill the colonists. They moved them. ROOK: Moved them where? VALE: Somewhere this machine can reach.

segments.continuity_out: Veyr commander stepping through partial portal
segments.dialogue: VOSS: This is not an occupation. It is reconnaissance. KESTREL: Commander, energy growth is exponential.

segments.continuity_out: Voss and commander locked in close combat while team splits
shots: Vale and Rook sprint opposite directions
segments.dialogue: VOSS: Ninety seconds. Break the gate and get to extraction. JAX: And you? VOSS: I am buying ninety seconds.

segments.continuity_out: gateway destabilizing as Rook climbs support spine
shots: Voss duel with powered armor physics
segments.dialogue: VALE: First coupling down. ROOK: I need twelve meters. JAX: You have six. Make it heroic.

segments.continuity_out: dropship smashing through outer facility wall
segments.dialogue: ROOK: Charge set! VALE: Run. KESTREL: I have selected the shortest route. VOSS: That is a wall. KESTREL: It was.

segments.continuity_out: dropship escaping exploding underground complex
segments.dialogue: JAX: Commander! VOSS: Go! KESTREL: Already doing so.

segments.continuity_out: cut to black after hundreds of signals
shots: camera pulls back as dark hemisphere fills with signals
segments.dialogue: ROOK: We stopped it. KESTREL: Commander... that was not the only signal. VOSS: How many? KESTREL: I am still counting.
